description.zh:
混合云集群 ID。
> 只针对混合云场景，您可以调用[DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~)获取混合云集群信息。
description.en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
> This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information.

description.zh: 查询的结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。
description.en: The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC) in seconds.
The dimension of the security event.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)查询当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

description.zh: 查询的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。
description.en: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC) in seconds.

description.zh:
安全事件统计的状态列表。
>默认统计 **toBeConfirmed**、**confirmed**、**actioned**状态的安全事件数据。
description.en:
The list of statuses for security event statistics.
>By default, security event data in the **toBeConfirmed**, **confirmed**, and **actioned** statuses is included in the statistics.

title.zh: 查询API安全用户安全事件类型和统计
title.en: Query API security event types and statistics

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-user-event-type --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-5y000h0t --cluster-id 976 --start-time 1723435200 --end-time 1726113600 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-aek000ktt3y --user-status-list toBeConfirmed --event-scope ip --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi DescribeUserEventType --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-aek000ktt3y' --UserStatusList.1 toBeConfirmed --EndTime 1726113600 --InstanceId 'waf_v2_public_cn-5y000h0t' --ClusterId 976 --EventScope ip --StartTime 1723435200 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --method POST --force
